full_name: Karine Chemla | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 History Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (France)
bio: In recent years, Karine Chemla’s research has focused on a single theoretical problem: that of understanding how one could describe collectively shared ways of doing science that our sources clearly evidence, without falling into the pitfalls of cultural essentialism.
